fact: 1920年10月16日，英国煤矿工人因要求每班增加2先令工资、降低家用煤价而全国罢工；罢工前会员投票以606,782票对238,865票赞成。政府于10月27日以238票对58票通过《紧急权力法案》，授权在罢工波及铁路与运输时宣布紧急状态。罢工持续约12天，至10月底按政府提出的临时方案复工。

sources.title: Strikes and Lock-outs，1922 Encyclopædia Britannica（Wikisource）
sources.quote: The coal strike began out of a demand put forward by the Miners' Federation of Great Britain (1) for a flat-rate advance in wages of 2s. a shift... A ballot of the Federation showed a great majority (606,782 to 238,865) in favour of a strike... work at the mines ceased on Oct. 16

sources.title: NEW HITCH OCCURS IN BRITISH STRIKE，The New York Times（1920-10-28）
sources.quote: The Government's Emergency bill... was rushed through all its remaining stages in the House of Commons today and passed the third and final reading tonight. The vote was 238 to 58.

sources.title: Coal，1926 Encyclopædia Britannica Supplement（Wikisource）
sources.quote: Although the mines were still under Government control, a national strike of the miners took place in Oct. 1920, and lasted for 12 days.

fact: 1920年11月21日，爱尔兰共和军在迈克尔·柯林斯指挥下于都柏林刺杀14名英国情报人员（“开罗帮”）；当日下午，皇家爱尔兰警察辅助部队向克罗克公园球场内的盖尔运动比赛观众开枪，都柏林城市档案记载球场内共14人死亡（含1名球员）、64人受伤，共发射278发步枪弹与50发机枪弹；《爱尔兰时报》的回顾则记12名平民死亡。当晚都柏林城堡又有3名在押者被枪杀。11月28日基尔迈克尔伏击战中，爱尔兰共和军击毙17名辅助部队成员。12月23日《1920年爱尔兰政府法》获御准，规定爱尔兰南北分治。

sources.title: Bloody Sunday exhibition booklet，Dublin City Library and Archive（2020）
sources.quote: In a couple of minutes of gunfire, 278 rifle rounds and 50 machine gun rounds were spent, killing eight spectators and one player outright, with five more dying of their wounds later; a further 64 were injured. Of the fourteen casualties, three – Jane Boyle, James Teehan and James Burke – were crushed in the stampede

sources.title: 1920-1929，The Irish Times
sources.quote: November 21st 1920: 'Bloody Sunday' begins with the assassination of 14 undercover British intelligence agents... In reprisal, Black and Tans kill 12 civilians when they open fire on a crowd at a Dublin-Tipperary football match in Croke Park... December 23rd 1920: Lloyd George's [Better] Government of Ireland Act provides for the states of Northern Ireland (six counties) and Southern Ireland (26 counties).

fact: 1920年11月11日，乔治五世在伦敦白厅揭幕阵亡将士纪念碑（Cenotaph），同日“无名战士”在威斯敏斯特教堂下葬；11月29日，一战期间实施的食糖配给取消。

sources.title: 1920 in the United Kingdom（Wikiwand）
sources.quote: 11 November – King George V unveils The Cenotaph in London; The Unknown Warrior is buried in Westminster Abbey... 29 November – Rationing imposed during World War I ends when the restriction on availability of sugar is lifted by the Government.

fact: 英国劳工部生活费用指数以1914年7月为100，1920年11月达到276的峰值，1921年1月为265、2月为251；指数按食品、房租、衣着、燃料与照明、杂项五组加权，权重取自1904年工人阶级家庭预算。另一个由Joint Committee on the Cost of Living所做的估算认为，1920年9月的总指数应为177而非官方161，差异主要来自食品与衣着权重。

sources.title: RETAIL PRICES IN ENGLAND; Decline of 15 Per Cent. from the High Mark in 1920，The New York Times（1921-03-20）
sources.quote: Based on 100 as the average for July, 1914, it gives last month's average as 251, comparing with 265 in January, and with 276 in November, the height of the advance.

sources.title: Commons Chamber，Hansard（1943-12-03）
sources.quote: If one assumes that the cost of living in July, 1914, was represented by a figure of 100, it had risen in 1920 to 276... The index figure is based upon budgets comprising a typical working-class family's expenditure in 1904.

sources.title: Final report on the cost of living，Joint Committee on the Cost of Living（London, 1921）
sources.quote: If we calculate the rise in the cost of living by using the Ministry of Labour's 'weights' and our percentage price increases... the cost of living figure for September, 1920, would be 177 as against the official figure of 161, a difference of 16 points.

fact: 《经济学人》批发物价指数由1920年3月的310.2降至1921年6月的178.6；工会报告的失业率由1920年4月的0.9%升至1921年同期的23.1%，参加失业保险行业的失业率在1921年6月为17.8%。

sources.title: Economic Reconstruction, Vol. 1（archive.org 全文）
sources.quote: wholesale prices from 310·2(Economist index) in March 1920 to 178·6 in June of the following year. Unemployment, as reported by Trade Unions, rose from 0·9 per cent. in April 1920 to the unprecedented figure of 23·1 per cent. at the end of the same period. Among insured trades the percentage reached 17·8 in June 1921.

fact: 《1920年失业保险法》（10 & 11 Geo. 5 c.30）于1920年8月9日获御准、11月8日施行，把失业保险扩大到约1,100万工人，覆盖除家庭服务、农业、铁路与公务员以外的绝大部分民用劳动力；提供15周失业给付，男子每周15先令、女子12先令，经费由雇主、雇员缴费与国库补助共同承担。该法通过时失业率很低，但1921年失业激增使支出远超预期。

sources.title: Unemployment Insurance Act 1920（Wikiwand）
sources.quote: Royal assent 9 August 1920... Commencement 8 November 1920... It set up the dole system that provided 15 weeks of unemployment benefits to cover over 11 million workers—practically the entire civilian working population except domestic service, farm workers, railway workers, and civil servants... it provided weekly payments of 15s for unemployed men and 12s for unemployed women.

fact: 《1920年租金与抵押利息（限制）法》允许受管制住宅的租金在标准租金基础上增加15%（补偿战时货币贬值），房东承担全部修缮时可再加25%，合计上限40%；但该法通过后一年内，15%的部分不得超过5%；租户或卫生机关可因房屋不宜居住向郡法院申请暂停加租。该法不适用于1919年4月2日已建成或正在建造的房屋。

sources.title: INCREASES IN RENT，Hansard（1950-06-13）
sources.quote: In the case of such houses, the Rent Restrictions Act. 1920, authorised increases of 15 per cent. of the net rent and a further 25 per cent. where the landlord was wholly responsible for repairs. Taken together, these two increases were known as the 40 per cent. increase.

sources.title: CLAUSE 2.—(Permitted Increases in Rent.)，Hansard（1920-06-21）
sources.quote: an amount equal to fifteen per cent. of the net rent: Provided that... the amount of such addition shall not during a period of one year after the passing of this Act exceed five per cent.

fact: 1920年4月15日，英格兰银行将银行贴现率提高到7%，并维持至1921年4月28日，是1914年以来最高、持续时间最长的高利率。此前的1919年11月6日已由5%升至6%。政策背景是坎利夫委员会建议恢复金本位、限制纸币发行：1919年12月15日的财政部备忘录把1920年纸币信用发行上限固定为320,600,000英镑。

sources.title: RATES OF BANK OF ENGLAND，The New York Times（1929-09-27）
sources.quote: The highest rate since 1918 was 7 per cent, established on April 15, 1920, and in effect until April 28, 1921.

sources.title: Economic Reconstruction, Vol. 1（archive.org 全文）
sources.quote: The Bank of England, having raised the Bank Rate to 6 per cent. on 6 November 1919, advanced it further to the exceptional level of 7 per cent. on 15 April 1920, and kept it there for twelve months... £320,600,000 was fixed as the maximum issue for 1920.

fact: 1920年6月15日晚，马可尼公司在切尔姆斯福德工厂以临时演播室播出澳大利亚女高音内莉·梅尔巴的独唱，由《每日邮报》赞助，被认为是英国首次预告的公众娱乐广播；信号远及伊朗与纽芬兰。英国邮政总局随后以干扰飞机与船舶通信为由撤销其在切尔姆斯福德的广播许可；1922年5月11日2LO在伦敦开播，10月18日英国广播公司（BBC）成立，11月14日开始全国节目。

sources.title: Guglielmo Marconi: Inventor, Scientist, Entrepreneur and Visionary，BBC History of the BBC
sources.quote: On June 15, 1920 the Marconi Company made what is considered to be 'the first pre-announced broadcast of public entertainment': a recital by the Australian opera soprano Dame Nellie Melba... on May 11, 1922 the London radio station, 2LO, started to send signals... Six months later, that studio became the first station of the British Broadcasting Company that was incorporated on October 18, 1922.

sources.title: 2LO calling: The birth of British public radio，Science Museum
sources.quote: Britain’s first advertised live public broadcast took place on 15 June 1920... this venture into entertainment proved too much for the General Post Office (GPO), which withdrew Marconi’s licence for broadcasting from Chelmsford... On 14 November 1922, Arthur Burrows... launched Britain’s first national radio broadcasting service from Marconi House in the Strand, London.

fact: 1919年《住房与城市规划法》（艾迪生法）承诺三年内由国库补贴建成50万套住房，实际到该法停止时只完成约213,000套；战后住房缺口估计至少50万套。1920年伦敦郡议会发行保证收益6%的住房债券，募集400万英镑用于公共住房建设。

sources.title: Council housing，UK Parliament
sources.quote: In 1919, Parliament passed the ambitious Housing Act which promised government subsidies to help finance the construction of 500,000 houses within three years... only 213,000 homes were completed under the Act's provisions.

sources.title: The Financing of House Building in Countries with Rent Restriction Legislation: II，International Labour Review（1928）
sources.quote: there was no question of making good the shortage of houses caused by the war (estimated at least half a million)

sources.title: Homes fit for Heroes: The Centenary of Council Houses，Bicester Local History Society
sources.quote: In 1920, the London County Council (LCC) introduced housing bonds at a guaranteed return of 6%. A total of £4m was raised to build new public housing.
